title: Many small tanks become a pipe

scenes.say: 2000 small stirred tanks in a row behave like one pipe.
One stirred tank, a first-order reaction, k tau = 2: conversion 0.667.
Split the same volume into more tanks in series, and conversion climbs toward the plug-flow reactor.
At 2000 tanks the gap is 1.35e-4, the size the error term predicts.

scenes.note: a chain needs 1354 tanks to pass
scenes.say: So the test allows 2e-4. A chain needs at least 1354 tanks to pass.
A round 1e-2 would pass with only 27 tanks. It could not tell 27 tanks from 2000.
Set a test's tolerance from the error term, not from habit.
